page.layout: One scanned page: the front board of a library binding, with no printed text. Blocks named in reading order: yellow shelf labels top left (a handwritten "6 / 1.B / 27" tag and a starred yellow label "6 / 1.5"); a blue cloth tab on the left edge; a rectangular library label in the centre ("Ex Bibliotheca majori Coll. Rom. Societ. Jesu"); handwritten pencil and ink shelf marks in the centre and lower left; a blue cloth tab at the bottom left.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The centre label is a printed library ownership label, not part of the book's text, so it is described here and not transcribed as main text. The yellow tags, blue tabs and handwritten marks (including "6.1.B.27", "470", "74", "A", "2412" and the pencilled letters) are library shelf marks and handwriting, which are excluded from the transcription.
